name: Cùng nhau xây nhà
notes: The couple put up a house on the card (the shared grown-up pair in templates/_models: Grab3D's Casual Man and Woman with Quaternius's animations, CC0, sized so the door is a grown-up's; he wears a code-built yellow hard hat and swings his hammer with his own arm, as the couple has no chop clip; bushes from KayKit City Builder Bits; the house, the tools and the props are built in story.js). Stop 1: a sky folds up behind the card; he tosses a rolled blueprint onto the card and it unrolls, the plan glows and the foundation rises out of it; she tosses him one brick at a time and each hammer strike snaps a course of bricks round the house; they cheer and a blueprint with the card's first words (slot note1) in its title block unrolls. Stop 2: the walls finish, the gables fold up, the roof goes on tile by tile and the chimney drops in; she paints the door with a roller, the window frames snap in, and the card's photo flies out of the round attic window with its caption (slot caption). Stop 3: dusk; the photo moves aside, a mailbox springs up, flowers pop out of the window boxes, the lights come on, the door opens and heart-shaped smoke rises from the chimney; they cheer in the doorway, an arm round each other, and a banner with the last words (slot note2) rises. The next tap opens the letter. The act is the shared templates/_acts/lovestory.js; this card's own moves are in story.js.
